silent_conclusion: The broad silent sequence conveys locked wet storage, an apparent plant source, a paper test, inside watering hardware and overflow. It does not faithfully carry the exact v3 split-connector mechanism or a decisive rear-route exclusion. Those failures cannot be repaired by the unchanged narration. Recurrence and exclusive key ownership remain spoken context.

findings.finding: The woman looks toward the camera with a nearly neutral smile instead of reacting to the evidence. Hair, face and rust/navy wardrobe remain visually consistent.
White mineral band is primarily on the pot exterior, rather than the scripted saucer inner rim; the spoken clue is visually imprecise.
Old streak appears on a side/front corner instead of clearly on the exterior back, weakening the proposed top-to-rear overflow route.
Paper does not visibly cover the entire rear-edge entry route. Its dryness therefore cannot visually exclude all of the proposed overhead overflow path as required by U01 v3.
Paper disappears after it was placed at 18–22 s, then reappears at 27 s. This breaks the test-state continuity despite the one correction request.

Lower hose vanishes in the leak close-up and reappears in the final shot. Water comes from the open connector end rather than a fine side split; generated imagery misrepresents the retained causal story.
The unnumbered clock has one prominent downward hand; exact six o'clock relies on narration, rather than two clearly readable hands.

continuity_summary: Inspected silent export and every dense strip, shots 01–12. No additional camera-driven clipping, seam exposure, wardrobe/hair change or shoe-shape jump was observed in these samples. Still photographs keep droplets frozen; SFX imply the event, with no animated water. Tray, shoes, reservoir and plant remain broadly recognizable, but the paper and hose-state failures are material.
fix_note: One resolution-sheet correction was requested before the first encode, targeting paper persistence, a connected inline hose, dry paper coverage and a smaller overflow. It improved the unnumbered clock and reduced the flood appearance but did not repair the important geometry/state defects. The rejected original is preserved. No second correction or second master was made.
quality_note: Technically complete; unresolved paper-test and connector-state errors break the intended v3 visual logic. Not a qualified storyboard.
